title: DORA ICT risk evidence
description: Questions for the ICT risk owner and evidence checks for financial entities under Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 (DORA). Apply the entity's approved interpretation and its competent authority's guidance; these rules do not establish compliance.

rules.instruction: Ask the compliance owner whether the organization is a financial entity or an ICT third-party service provider within DORA Art. 2, and which business functions the changed system supports.
rules.verification: Link the recorded answer and the business functions from the change.
rules.manual: Whether the organization is a financial entity under DORA is a legal assessment of the compliance owner.

rules.instruction: Add the new or changed ICT assets, the business functions they support and their dependencies to the inventory the entity keeps under Art. 8.
rules.verification: Find the inventory entry of each new component with its owner, classification and dependencies.

evidence.title: Inventory of ICT assets and the business functions they support

rules.manual: The ICT asset inventory is kept outside the repository; its entry is named evidence.

rules.instruction: Ask the ICT risk owner which backup scope and frequency apply to the changed data (Art. 12), and include the system in the restoration tests.
rules.verification: Link the latest restoration test record that covers the changed system.
rules.manual: Backup scope and restoration tests run on the entity's infrastructure and are recorded outside the repository.

rules.instruction: Make the incident template of the changed service capture the criteria used to classify ICT-related incidents under Art. 18, such as clients affected, duration and data losses.
rules.verification: Open the incident template and check that it records each Art. 18 criterion.
rules.manual: The incident template lives in the entity's incident tool; a person checks its fields.

rules.instruction: When the change adds an ICT third-party service, ask the procurement owner to add the contractual arrangement to the register of information (Art. 28(3)).
rules.verification: Check that the register lists the provider, the service and the business functions it supports.

evidence.title: Register of information on ICT third-party contractual arrangements

rules.manual: The register of information is kept outside the repository; its entry is named evidence.

rules.instruction: Ask the legal owner to review a new ICT service contract against the key contractual provisions of Art. 30.
rules.verification: Link the legal owner's recorded review from the change.
rules.manual: Contract review is the legal owner's assessment of a signed contract.

rules.instruction: Ask the ICT risk owner whether the changed system enters the digital operational resilience testing programme (Art. 24 and 25), and record the planned test.
rules.verification: Check that the testing programme lists the system or that the owner recorded why it is out of scope.
rules.manual: The testing programme is the ICT risk owner's plan, kept outside the repository.
